desiredFields.description:
Porchivo is the premium delivery protection and community coordination platform for homes, HOAs, condos, and multi-unit communities. It helps residents, staff, and managers keep packages secure, reduce delivery friction, and maintain a more organized property experience.

Porchivo replaces cluttered handoffs, missed updates, and package uncertainty with a streamlined system built for visibility and control. Residents can stay informed when deliveries arrive. Staff can manage package flow with less interruption. Managers can maintain a clearer, more accountable process from drop-off to pickup.

Whether you are protecting a single residence or coordinating across a larger community, Porchivo brings structure to one of the most overlooked parts of daily operations. It helps reduce confusion, improve communication, and create a more secure, polished delivery workflow that feels intentional instead of improvised.

Features

Secure package tracking.

Delivery status updates.

Pickup coordination for residents and staff.

Clear visibility for HOAs, condos, and multi-unit properties.

Reduced missed deliveries and manual follow-up.

A refined experience built for communities that value order, security, and professionalism.

desiredFields.whatsNew:
Live Delivery Map with real-time tracking and smart route insights:

• Real-time countdown timer showing exact minutes and seconds until arrival
• Estimated arrival time (ETA) calculated from live countdown duration
• Auto-zoom map that frames the full delivery route automatically
• Route progress highlighting — see traveled vs. remaining portions at a glance
• Night map mode for comfortable nighttime tracking
• Traffic overlay with green, yellow, and red congestion segments along the route
• Distance unit switching between kilometers and miles
• Pulsing route indicator dot when delivery is under 15 minutes away
• Driver location marker displayed on arrival
• Subtle sound notification when your delivery countdown reaches zero

Performance improvements and stability fixes throughout.
